current_prompt.body:
READ numbers from 1 to 100
FOR each number
IF the number is divisible by 15 THEN OUTPUT "FizzBuzz"
ELSE IF the number is divisible by 3 THEN OUTPUT "Fizz"
ELSE IF the number is divisible by 5 THEN OUTPUT "Buzz"
ELSE OUTPUT the number
END FOR
